name: Improvised Weapon

boost.name: Investigate
effect: The opponent discards a card at random. If it is a Special Attack, they must discard an additional card of their choice.
HIT: If the opponent initiated this Strike, return this card to your hand. Otherwise gain Gain Advantage.

name: Disarming Strike

boost.name: Disarming Maneuver
effect: Advance 2. If you switched sides with the opponent, they discard a card a random.
HIT: The opponent must discard a Normal Attack, or reveal a hand with none.

name: Cease & Desist
effect: Whenever you would discard cards during this Strike, discard 1 fewer card.
AFTER: Draw a card and lose all Armor.

name: Power Short

boost.name: Precision Engineering
effect: Return a Normal from your gauge to your hand. If you did, add this card to your gauge.
AFTER: Lose all Armor. If you did not hit the opponent, you take 3 damage.

boost.name: Overload
effect: You may place this card face-down with any Normal Attack to form an EX Attack.

name: Autonomic Response

boost.name: Overload
effect: You may place this card face-down with any Normal Attack to form an EX Attack.
Normal Attacks do not hit you.
